sculpture.title: Model house on wooden stilts. Split level house with pitched roof and small extended porch; two ladders leading up to openable doors made from slats of wood tied together with nylon cord; walls, roof and two openable window made from leaves stitched together with pink plastic ribbon; openings decorated with knotted pink and natural plant fibre and with pieces of cotton cloth; ties of plastic ribbon, nylon cord cotton cord and plant fibre used throughout; two rectangular woven mats inside the house.

other.title: Plant leaves used as sandpaper [.1 - .2] in a frame. [L.Ph 'DCF 2004-2006 What's Upstairs?' 23/11/2004]
